intent: Minimal premium dot-matrix display that adds character: cycles scenes with a per-dot dissolve.

layout.matrix: 72x16 default; pitch = width/cols; dpr capped at 2
layout.caption: scene counter + label left, prev/pause/next right
layout.structure: hooks useSceneCycle, useMicrophone, useMatrixCanvas; sub-components Caption, IconButton, MicButton; runtime state the draw loop reads (scene index, dissolve start, sweep start, pointer) lives in one ref, never React state

typography.bitmapFont: 5x7, A–Z 0–9 : . - / % +, 1px glyph gap, 2x scale when rows >= 16

color.bloom: shadowBlur in dot colour, grows with brightness level
color.tokens: PALETTE: panel #070707, line white/8%, off dots white/5.5%, caption white/45%, controls white/60% (hover white, bg white/6%), progress track white/10% fill the dot colour at 70%, mic blocked #f87171; exposed as --pmd-* CSS variables
color.accent: color prop (default #f5f5f0) is the one accent: lit dots, bloom, the progress line and the live mic dot

motion.dissolve: per-dot stable random threshold vs 700ms progress
motion.clockColon: always rasterised (width-stable); breathes with a 1Hz cosine fade 22–100%
motion.reducedMotion: no autoplay (prev/next still work), no sweep or pointer glow, 150ms fades; each scene freezes on a representative still (marquee and clock at t=0, others at t=2)
motion.pointer: dots within ~4 of the cursor warm up (unlit) or step up a level (lit); eases 12% per frame
motion.hold: hover holds the scene; a progress line fills over the interval and pauses while held
motion.chrome: label swaps with AnimatePresence: in 6px/2px blur over 320ms, out up 6px in 160ms ease-in; buttons press to 0.9
motion.powerOn: once at 30% in view: the panel rises 12px out of an 8px blur (0.5s ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1]); at 0.22s the dots power on in a bright column sweeping left to right over 0.75s (front = x/cols with 3.5% per-dot jitter, band 5% wide drawn at full brightness; dots ahead of it are dark, behind it show the scene); the marquee text starts at the left edge and holds still while the sweep writes it in, and scene time starts once the sweep has passed; caption and controls follow at 0.5s and 0.56s; scenes begin to cycle only after power-on
motion.marquee: starts with the text at the left edge (ox = cols − ((t·14 + cols) mod total)), scrolls left and wraps in from the right
motion.cycle: one progress motion value animates 0→1 linearly over the interval and advances the scene on complete; the same value is the caption progress line's scaleX, so holding (hover, pause, mic) stops both and resuming continues
motion.equaliserVoice: unchanged from the approved version: log-spaced frequency bands from an AnalyserNode (fftSize 256) drive the bars with fast attack / slow release and falling peak dots

responsive.all: matrix scales to container width; dot count stays constant so the art never reflows
responsive.narrow: below @md the mic control shrinks to its dot (aria-label keeps the meaning) so the caption never wraps

accessibility: canvas role=img with aria-label naming the scene (and marquee text)
avoid: CSS keyframe progress lines or label animations
a display that pops in fully lit

interaction.microphone: Opt-in 'Use mic' toggle: getUserMedia + AnalyserNode (fftSize 256), log-spaced bands to bars, fast attack / slow release, falling peak-hold dots; holds the equaliser scene; stops all tracks on toggle, scene change or unmount; blocked permission shows 'Mic blocked'.
interaction.scene: Optional prop: holds the display on that scene. Jumps to it when the value changes and pauses auto-advance while set; prev and next still step.
